headline: EPS edges higher on both comparisons
summary_short: Ohishi Sangyo reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥27.73, up 7.2% y/y from ¥25.86.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥27.73 rose 7.2% year-over-year from ¥25.86, and was up 14.6% sequentially from ¥24.20 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
